Silent-if-unmapped is the law: every absent key below is a CHOSEN silence (menu TBD, overworld doctrine, in-duel focus, interiors pending ambience). Underscore keys are documentation.

_sfx: S24 r2-r3: the SFX channel. Sequencing (Chris): CAST rings the TYPE (sfx.cast.creature=Summon etc.); ENTERING PLAY rings the COLOUR (sfx.enter.W..G at Chris's 0.2; guild pairs sfx.enter.WU.., artifact, colorless mappable by data). Actions: draw/shuffle (mulligan+search only)/tap/untap (one per untap-step burst)/attack (one per commit)/end-turn. Volumes are 0..1 multipliers tuned at /sound; non-colour values are implementer first guesses.
